name: buy_plugin
description: Buy a plugin found in the marketplace (see list_store_plugins) that the customer doesn't already hold a license for. Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to buy it -- never speculatively. Buying also makes the plugin installable -- there is no separate install_plugin call needed afterward; use the returned `plugin_id` directly with get_plugin_capabilities/call_plugin_tool. NOTE: this is currently a stub -- there is no real purchase API yet, so this always simulates success.
